title: Project scaffold: Makefile, Kbuild, directory tree
description: wolfkm.ko needs a working build system before any source files can be written. This issue creates the full directory structure (src/reg/, src/cdev/, include/uapi/, tests/kernel/, tests/userspace/, tests/vectors/, tests/ci/, tools/, scripts/, docs/, human_tasks/), the Makefile, and Kbuild file. Must compile to a valid (empty-stub) .ko with zero warnings on both kernel 5.15 and 6.8.
design: Makefile variables: WOLFCRYPT_DIR (default /usr/local/src/wolfssl), WOLFKM_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT (default 0 for stub mode). wolfkm-objs lists all nine .o files from src/wolfkm_main.o through src/cdev/wolfkm_session.o. ccflags-y adds -I$(WOLFCRYPT_DIR) -DWOLFKM_MODULE. See DESIGN.md §Build System.
